capabilities: Display today's TaskNotes tasks grouped by date in a collapsible list
Show stat tiles for todo, overdue, unplanned, and events that filter the agenda on click
Add tasks through quick title entry or the full TaskNotes creator
Embed the agenda in notes with a configurable code block (title, days, events)
Optionally interleave TaskNotes calendar events (ICS, Google, Microsoft) with tasks by time
disambiguation: Not a task manager; it only reads and displays tasks that TaskNotes already indexes.
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installable via BRAT as a beta plugin. Calendar events depend on TaskNotes's own fetching, so a TaskNotes storage change would silently stop events while the rest of the agenda keeps working.
intentEvidence: Requires the TaskNotes. plugin. This reads your TaskNotes tasks; it does not manage tasks on its own.
problem: Obsidian users of TaskNotes lack a single today's-agenda view that groups open tasks by date alongside overdue and unplanned items.

relations.evidence: A display of all your task notes in a today's agenda window for.

summary: Agenda wrapper for TaskNotes that shows today's tasks in a date-grouped sidebar pane or embedded block with stat tiles and quick task entry.
